description_en: Returns details for a specified change set, optionally including the details of its associated template
description_zh: 查询指定更改集信息，可以选择是否获取对应模板详情
kebab_example: aliyun ros get-change-set --show-template false --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --change-set-id 4c11658d-bd47-4dd0-ba64-727edc620000 --region cn-hangzhou
name: GetChangeSet

parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether to return the template. Valid values:

true: The template is returned.

false (default): The template is not returned
parameters.help_zh:
是否获取模板，取值：

true：获取模板。
false（默认值）：不获取模板
parameters.name: show_template

parameters.help_en: The ID of the region to which the change set belongs. You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/131035.html operation to query the latest list of Alibaba Cloud regions
parameters.help_zh: 更改集所属的地域ID。您可以调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/131035.html查看最新的阿里云地域列表
parameters.name: region_id

parameters.help_en: The ID of the change set
parameters.name: change_set_id

ChangeSetId.description_en: The ID of the change set

ChangeSetName.description_en: The name of the change set

ChangeSetType.description_en: The type of the change set

Changes.description_en: The changes in the change set

items.description_en:
A change in the change set.

For more information, see [change set data structure]（https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/155988.html）
items.description_zh:
更改集变更内容列表。

更多信息，请参见[更改集数据结构]（https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/155988.html）

CreateTime.description_en: The time when the change set was created. The time is in UTC and uses the `YYYY-MM-DDThh:mm:ss` format
CreateTime.description_zh: 创建时间，按照ISO8601标准表示，并需要使用UTC时间。格式为：YYYY-MM-DDThh:mm:ss

Description.description_en: The description of the change set

DisableRollback.description_en: Indicates whether to disable rollback when a stack creation or update fails
DisableRollback.description_zh: 资源栈在创建或更新失败时是否回滚

ExecutionStatus.description_en: The execution status of the change set

TerraformLogs.description_en:
The Terraform output logs. This parameter is returned only for change sets of Terraform-based stacks.

This parameter is unavailable while a change set is being created because the logs are generated only after the creation is complete
TerraformLogs.description_zh:
Terraform输出日志。仅Terraform类型资源栈的更改集返回该参数。

创建中的更改集不返回该参数。该参数表示创建更改集的日志

Command.description_en:
The name of the Terraform command that was executed. Valid values:

apply

plan

destroy

version

For more information about the commands, see Command (https://www.terraform.io/cli/commands)
Command.description_zh:
执行的Terraform命令名称。取值：

apply

plan

destroy

version

关于命令含义的更多信息，请参见Command (https://www.terraform.io/cli/commands)

Content.description_en: The content that the command wrote to the specified stream
Content.description_zh: 当前命令在当前输出流中输出的内容
Content.example: Apply complete! Resources: 42 added, 0 changed, 0 destroyed.

Stream.description_en:
The output stream. Valid values:

`stdout`: standard output

`stderr`: standard error
Stream.description_zh:
输出流。取值：

stdout：标准输出。

stderr：标准错误

ResourceGroupId.description_en:
The ID of the resource group.
For more information about resource groups, see [What is a resource group?]（https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/94475.html）.
ResourceGroupId.description_zh:
资源组ID。  
关于资源组的更多信息，请参见[什么是资源组]（https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/94475.html）

StackId.description_en: The ID of the stack to which the change set belongs

StackName.description_en: The name of the stack to which the change set belongs

Status.description_en: The status of the change set

StatusReason.description_en: The reason for the change set's abnormal status

Tags.description_en: The tags of the change set

items.description_en: A tag applied to the change set

TemplateBody.description_en:
The template body of the change set.

This parameter is returned only when `ShowTemplate` is set to `true`
TemplateBody.description_zh:
更改集对应的模板。

当ShowTemplate为true时该参数有效

TimeoutInMinutes.description_en: The timeout period for creating or updating the stack
TimeoutInMinutes.description_zh: 资源栈创建或更新超时时间
